name: Custom Shape 2-Layer 3D Acrylic Fridge Magnet
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality acrylic for a sturdy, durable, and long-lasting finish.
    - Features a layered 3D structure that creates depth and a more eye-catching display.
    - The base piece is made from 5mm acrylic, providing a solid and stable foundation.
    - The insert piece includes two acrylic layers, each made from 3mm acrylic, to enhance the 3D effect.
    - Includes a strong magnet on the back of the base for secure attachment to refrigerators and other magnetic surfaces.
    - The insert piece is finished with a magnetic sheet back, allowing it to attach neatly to the base.
    - Smooth acrylic surface helps showcase printed artwork clearly with a clean, polished look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Base size: 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
    - Insert piece thickness: 0.19 in ~ 0.5 cm
    - Minimum insert piece size: 0.78 in ~ 2 cm
    - Maximum insert piece size: 3 in ~ 7.62 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Base piece: 1-sided printing
    - Insert Piece Layer 1: 2-sided printing
    - Insert Piece Layer 2: 1-sided printing

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Used as a decorative fridge magnet for refrigerators, magnetic boards, lockers, filing cabinets, and other metal surfaces.
    - The magnetic base helps the product attach securely and stay in place during daily use.
    - The removable insert piece creates a fun 3D layered display effect when attached to the base.
    - Ideal for decorating kitchens, offices, classrooms, dorm rooms, and personal workspaces.
    - Great for showcasing custom artwork such as names, pets, holiday themes, cute characters, or seasonal designs.
    - Compact and lightweight, making it easy to place, remove, and reposition when needed.
    - Suitable for everyday decoration or as a small collectible keepsake.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun gift idea for family, friends, kids, and coworkers.
    - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, Christmas, Halloween, and other seasonal celebrations.
    - Great for people who love cute custom magnets and personalized home decor.
    - A lovely choice for pet lovers, character-themed gifts, and family keepsakes.
    - Suitable for decorating refrigerators, lockers, or personal workspaces with a custom touch.
    - Ideal for anyone looking for a small, unique, and meaningful personalized gift.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer 3D Acrylic Fridge Magnet

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
